title: Midterm Endorsements and Coverage Changes — HomeGuard Homeowners Policy Rate Manual
content:
## Section 1. When a change can be made

1.1 Endorsements on a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy are added or removed only while the policy is bound, in force or pending nonrenewal, as the policy record shows.

1.2 A midterm change takes effect no earlier than the date the named insured requests it and before the expiration date.

1.3 Coverage increases are not accepted while the policy has a claim that has been reported and not closed. A coverage increase is any raise of Coverage A, Coverage C, Coverage E or the water backup limit, and any addition of the service line, equipment breakdown or identity fraud endorsement. Deductible changes and removals are not increases.

1.4 While the customer holds a live Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy that schedules this policy as underlying, Coverage E is never lowered below the umbrella's required underlying homeowners liability limit.

## Section 2. What may be changed

| Item | Permitted change |
|---|---|
| Water backup | bought in steps of 5000 above the package's included water backup limit, up to the package's maximum water backup limit; the endorsement records the new total water backup limit |
| Service line, equipment breakdown, identity fraud | bought only when the package's included limit for that coverage is 0, and then at the package's endorsement limit |
| Coverage A | must stay within the package's minimum and maximum Coverage A |
| Coverage C | must stay between 40 percent and 100 percent of Coverage A |
| Coverage E | must land on one of the package's liability limit options |
| All-other-perils deductible | must land on one of the package's all-other-perils deductible options |
| Wind/hail deductible percentage | changes only at renewal |
| Removal | coverages included in the package can never be removed; only purchased water backup limit and the service line, equipment breakdown and identity fraud endorsements can be removed |

## Section 3. Annual premium change

| Change | Annual premium change |
|---|---|
| Water backup | the package's water backup rate per 5000 for each step of 5000 bought or removed |
| Service line, equipment breakdown or identity fraud | the package's annual premium for that endorsement |
| Coverage A | the package's Coverage A rate per 1000 for each 1000 USD of change |
| Coverage C | 3.15 for each 1000 USD of change |
| Coverage E | the package's liability step premium for each step moved along the liability limit options |
| All-other-perils deductible | the term premium multiplied by the new deductible's factor less the old deductible's factor |

Deductible factors:

| Deductible | 500 | 1000 | 2500 | 5000 | 10000 | 25000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Factor | 0.06 | 0.00 | minus 0.11 | minus 0.19 | minus 0.27 | minus 0.36 |

## Section 4. Prorating and billing

4.1 The prorated premium is the annual change multiplied by the calendar days from the change effective date to the expiration date, divided by the calendar days in the term, rounded half-up to the cent.

4.2 An increase is billed as additional premium and a decrease is credited as return premium. When the prorated amount is below the package's minimum premium change, the direction is none and nothing is billed or credited.

4.3 The term premium is not restated midterm; the change reaches the next term through the renewal offer.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, 365-day term)

- *Coverage C raised by 20000 with 219 days left:* annual change 3.15 for each of 20 thousands, 63.00; prorated 63.00 multiplied by 219, divided by 365, gives 37.80, billed as additional premium where the package's minimum premium change is 10.00.
- *Deductible moved from 1000 to 2500 on a term premium of 1500.00 with 73 days left:* factor change minus 0.11 less 0.00, so the annual change is a decrease of 165.00; prorated 165.00 multiplied by 73, divided by 365, gives 33.00, credited as return premium.
- *Water backup raised from an included 5000 to 15000 on a hypothetical rate of 45.00 per 5000:* two steps, annual change 90.00.
- *Small change:* a prorated amount of 4.20 against a minimum premium change of 5.00 is neither billed nor credited.
